title: Converting crafted ISO-2022-CN-EXT input to UTF-8 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.2 through 2.44…
description: A vulnerability in the GNU C Library (glibc) versions 2.2 through 2.44 exists in the ISO-2022-CN-EXT to UTF-8 conversion function. When processing crafted input containing invalid byte sequences, the decoder may read past the end of the input buffer, causing the application to crash. This is a denial-of-service condition triggered by attacker-controlled input.
